documents.content: AgentIQ Enterprise Platform Report. In fiscal year 2026, total recurring enterprise revenue grew by 28.5 percent to 45.2 million dollars. Operating margin expanded by 340 basis points reaching 21.2 percent. The company completed SOC-2 Type II certification and FedRAMP readiness audits across all North American cloud regions. International expansion into EMEA and APAC generated 38 percent of new client acquisitions.

Enterprise Security and Access Policy. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all administrative access. Service-to-service communication requires mutual TLS with quarterly key rotations. Database analytics accounts must operate strictly under least-privilege read-only permissions with statement timeouts capped at 3000 milliseconds. Customer data retention is bounded by strict 7-year audit retention schedules.
